name: Vitamin D3 + K2 drops
identity: Vitamin D3 with vitamin K2 in MCT oil taken as drops, 1,000 to 2,000 IU vitamin D per daily drop; the dose is one drop.
rule: Per 100 g of the product, each value is the median of the labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three declare it; a label states its nutrients per dose, so the file converts them with the dose's weight (the pack's net content divided by its count of tablets, capsules, sticks or drops, or the stated dose weight). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Fewer than three labels declare energy, so the row stands at 0 kcal under the verification policy's clause for label generics with a micronutrient. Liquid labels give volumes; each label's serving note names the density that turns them into grams. Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from dm.de, rossmann.de and shop-apotheke.com product pages.
